info.title: Cocoon Status Callback Endpoint
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Cocoon-hosted status callback endpoint (POST https://dashboard.flutter.dev/api/v1/partner/callback). Used by the partner to report CI execution status back to Cocoon for a given uid—both for optional start notifications (status: in_progress) and for required terminal status updates (succeeded, failed, infra_failure, cancelled, neutral, or skipped).

post.summary: Report Partner CI Execution Status to Cocoon
post.description: Receives a raw Ed25519-signed JWT from a Partner CI reporting either an optional start notification (status: in_progress) or a required terminal status update for a given uid. Maximum request body size is 768 KB. All details[].url links MUST use https://. Because the Flutter build dashboard is public, message summaries and details[].url links submitted to Cocoon MUST NOT contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets. The partner CI SHOULD retry with exponential backoff on timeouts, 408, 429, or 5xx responses.

requestBody.description: Raw Ed25519-signed JWT in JWS Compact Serialization (<Base64Url JWT Header>.<Base64Url JWT Payload>.<Base64Url Signature>) signed with the partner's private key. The decoded JWT header conforms to #/components/schemas/JwtHeader and the decoded JWT payload conforms to #/components/schemas/CocoonCallbackJwtPayload.

200.description: Status update accepted by Cocoon. Done; do not retry.

400.description: Bad Request — payload schema validation error or non-HTTPS log URL. Do not retry; fix payload construction.

401.description: Unauthorized — unknown kid, expired token, or invalid JWT signature. Do not retry; verify signing key and JWKS endpoint.

404.description: Not Found — data.uid does not exist in Cocoon. Do not retry.

408.description: Request Timeout — temporary server or network timeout. Partner CI should retry with exponential backoff.

409.description: Conflict — terminal status or a duplicate in_progress status was already processed for data.uid. Treat as idempotent success; do not retry.

413.description: Payload Too Large — request body exceeds the 768 KB limit. Do not retry; truncate message or details[].

429.description: Too Many Requests — temporary rate limit exceeded. Partner CI should retry with exponential backoff.

5XX.description: Server Error — temporary server failure. Partner CI should retry with exponential backoff.

SignedJwt.title: Signed JWT (JWS Compact Serialization)
SignedJwt.description: Compact JWS string (<Base64Url Header>.<Base64Url Payload>.<Base64Url Signature>) signed with the partner's Ed25519 private key (alg: EdDSA). See JwtHeader and CocoonCallbackJwtPayload for the decoded JSON structures.

JwtHeader.title: Decoded JWT Header
JwtHeader.description: JWS header parameters for Ed25519-signed tokens.

alg.description: Cryptographic signing algorithm. Must be 'EdDSA' (Ed25519 per RFC 8037).

kid.description: Key ID identifying the partner's Ed25519 public key in the partner's JWKS endpoint (partner_keys_url).

CocoonCallbackJwtPayload.title: Decoded Cocoon Status Callback JWT Payload (v1)
CocoonCallbackJwtPayload.description: Decoded JWT claims sent by Partner CI to POST https://dashboard.flutter.dev/api/v1/partner/callback.

iss.description: Issuer claim identifying the partner (must match the configured 'partner' identifier in Cocoon).

aud.description: Audience claim matching the exact Cocoon v1 callback endpoint URL.

CocoonCallbackData.title: Cocoon Status Callback Data
CocoonCallbackData.description: CI execution status and optional test suite details for a given uid. When status is a terminal status, details[].status must also be a terminal status (not in_progress).

uid.description: Unique correlation identifier matching the CI execution request dispatched by Cocoon.

message.description: Optional Markdown-formatted summary of the CI run (expected when status is 'failed' or 'infra_failure'). Must not contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets.

name.description: Name of the test suite or device target.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for test execution logs or details. Must not contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets.

ExecutionStatus.title: Execution Status
ExecutionStatus.description: in_progress is allowed only in optional start callbacks; terminal callbacks must use one of succeeded, neutral, skipped, failed, infra_failure, or cancelled.

TerminalExecutionStatus.title: Terminal Execution Status
TerminalExecutionStatus.description: Terminal execution status values. When data.status is terminal, all data.details[].status entries must also be terminal.

AckResponse.title: Acknowledgment Response
AckResponse.description: Empty JSON object returned on HTTP 200 OK.

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: Standard JSON error response body returned on HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses.
